y-m-01-10.title: Haddii aad isku xidho saddex-geesoodyo, immisa dab-shiide ayaa loo baahan yahay?
y-m-01-10.topic: Dab-shiidayaasha iyo saddex-geesoodyada (marka dhinacyadu is dul dhacaan)

Waxaad isku xidhaysaa saddex-geesoodyo hal saf ah adigoo isticmaalaya dab-shiidayaal. Saddex-geesoodyada ku xiga waxay wadaagaan hal dab-shiide. 1 saddex-geesood waxaad u baahan tahay 3 dab-shiide, 2 saddex-geesood 5, 3 saddex-geesood-na 7.
Tirada saddex-geesoodyada | 1 | 2 | 3
Tirada dab-shiidayaasha | 3 | 5 | 7
Seohyeon wuxuu rabaa inuu ogaado immisa dab-shiide ayaa loo baahan yahay qaab ka samaysan isku xidhidda 5 saddex-geesood.
